name: Build and ship an MVP
blurb: From idea to a live first version: spec, data model, sign-in and payments, screens, tests, security and deploy.
description: Take a product idea to a deployed first version from one request: the job to be done and a short PRD, scope cut to the MVP, database schema and API, sign-in and payments, the screens, tests, a security pass and deploy with CI and monitoring, using the Skill Garden product-management, backend-databases, frontend-ui-design, testing-qa, security and cloud-devops super skills in order. Use when asked to build an MVP, a SaaS, a first version or a prototype real users can sign up to.
ask: Build an MVP of <product> for <users>, so they can <main job>.
inputs: The problem and who has it
The one job the first version must do
Must-haves (sign-in, payments, teams) and what can wait
Stack or hosting you already use or prefer
Deadline and budget for paid services

steps.title: Find the job and write the spec
steps.output: A one-page PRD: the job, the users, the success metric and what is out of scope.

steps.title: Cut to the MVP
steps.output: Ranked stories, the cut line and the order to build them.

steps.title: Design the data and API
steps.output: Tables with keys and constraints, migrations and the API endpoints.

steps.title: Add sign-in and payments
steps.output: Working sign-up, sessions and roles, and Stripe Checkout with webhooks if it charges.

steps.title: Build the screens
steps.output: Each screen with its loading, empty, error and success states.

steps.title: Test the key flows
steps.output: A test plan and end-to-end tests for sign-up, the main job and payment.

steps.title: Security pass
steps.output: Threats found and fixed, secrets out of the code, and the risks that remain.

steps.title: Deploy with CI and monitoring
steps.output: The live app, a pipeline that tests before it deploys, and alerts on errors.
